title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree

contractDetails.constraints: 0–10,000 nodes with values in [−1,000, 1,000]. Deserialize receives a string produced by serialize.

statement: Implement two operations. Serialize a tree into a string, then deserialize that string into a tree with the same values and shape. Choose any reversible format. The judge shows the tree before and after the round trip as level-order arrays.

examples.explanation: The missing left child and the right subtree survive the round trip.
The format represents an empty tree.
Equal values preserve their separate positions.

constraints: 0–10,000 nodes with values in [−1,000, 1,000]. Deserialize receives a string produced by serialize.
hints: Conceptual: A sequence of values alone cannot tell left-only and right-only children apart.
Directional: Record missing child slots explicitly and agree on one traversal order for both operations.
Implementation: Read tokens in the same order you wrote them. For level order, keep a queue of non-null parents awaiting child slots.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space including the serialized representation and queue, excluding the new tree.
